cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pass hasn't been signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call her to check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pass hasn't been signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call her to check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's your own stamp.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

cards.title: Rank Everything

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.
